title: General education breadth or elective
description: A general education course (an academic inquiry seminar or a breadth course in the arts, humanities, or social sciences), or an elective.
notes: CWRU: the Unified General Education Requirement.

title: Open elective
description: A free elective chosen by the student.

title: Computer science breadth course
description: An upper-level computer science course chosen from one of four breadth areas, such as databases, software engineering, computer architecture, networks, operating systems, compilers, theory, security, programming languages, data analysis, artificial intelligence, or machine learning.
notes: CWRU: eight breadth courses, at least two from each of four areas.

title: Calculus for Science and Engineering II or Calculus II
description: Second-semester calculus: techniques and applications of integration, sequences and series, and an introduction to differential equations.
notes: Choice slot: CWRU's MATH 122 or MATH 124.

title: Calculus for Science and Engineering III or Calculus III
description: Multivariable calculus: vectors, partial derivatives, multiple integrals, and vector calculus.
notes: Choice slot: CWRU's MATH 223 or MATH 227.

title: Introduction to Linear Algebra for Applications or Linear Algebra
description: Linear algebra: systems of linear equations, matrices, vector spaces, linear transformations, determinants, eigenvalues, and eigenvectors.
notes: Choice slot: CWRU's MATH 201 or MATH 307.

title: Statistics elective
description: A course in probability or statistics: random variables, distributions, estimation, and hypothesis testing.
notes: Choice slot: CWRU's MATH 380, OPRE 207, STAT 302, STAT 312, STAT 313, STAT 332, or STAT 333.

title: Technical elective
description: An upper-level computer science course, or a related course in engineering, mathematics, or science, chosen from an approved list.
notes: CWRU: any CSDS course or the approved Group 1 and Group 2 lists.
